description: This file defines the Template class for the Opencart e-commerce system, providing methods for adding paths, rendering templates, and compiling template code.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: Provides functionality to manage template paths and render templates within Opencart's system.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a namespace and directory path for templates.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a template file with the provided data, compiling if necessary.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles template code into a PHP cache file.
